claim: DECISIVE: opus-coder alone (with sonnet/haiku on remaining 8 roles) DOES NOT bridge detecting's schema gate. X208 ran the spec X208 routing — opus-coder, sonnet on designer/evaluator/judge/selector/reviser/aggregator, haiku on setup+splitter — and produced invalid_submission ('Submission should have an Comment column') at $8.85. Combined with E020's 9-deep negative streak (including X218 sonnet+opus-coder-with-haiku-rest, which already hinted at this), the opus-coder-alone hypothesis is now CLOSED. Detecting requires opus on MORE than just coder — most plausibly the (coder, evaluator) pair or (coder, designer) pair, or opus-everywhere. Phase 1 opus-everywhere $341.83 gold remains the only known working configuration. The schema gate is structurally multi-role, not a single-role lever.

scope: DECISIVE conclusion of the detecting routing exploration. 10 distinct routings tested across Phase 2 + 1 Phase 1 baseline. ~$62 spent on detecting probes in Phase 2.

opus-{coder + designer} — design quality may matter as much as coder

practical_policy_for_detecting: Set policy.json[detecting-insults]: opus-everywhere. The opus-coder-alone hypothesis is refuted; the multi-role minimal-set hypothesis is open but very expensive to probe (each pair-of-opus probe ~$10-30). Routing on detecting is not a cost lever; it is a tier preserver only. Per-NODE routing (per-node-routing M2-followup) may eventually be the right tool — spend opus per-role only on the nodes near the medal threshold — but at the routing-strategy level, single-role opus-coder is decisively NOT enough.
limitations: We did NOT test {coder + evaluator} pair, {coder + designer} pair, or {coder + aggregator} pair. The pair-of-opus hypothesis is open.

implications.detecting_routing_minimal_config: Schema gate requires MORE than single-role opus-coder. Cheapest known: opus-everywhere $342 gold.
implications.next_actions_on_detecting: STOP single-role probes. If anyone wants to keep probing, try opus-{coder + evaluator} next (untried pair containing opus-coder). Otherwise, freeze detecting routing at opus-everywhere and pivot effort to per-node routing where the cost lever may live.
